Name: [LendingClub] Default / loss / prepayment rates must be measured on matured loans (LC.MaturedOnly)
Description: Young loans have not had time to default, so a rate over all loans understates risk. Every default, loss or prepayment rate goes through LC.MaturedOnly, a Matured* measure / Loans[Is Matured], or reuses [Default Rate] / [Loss Rate]. Rates that are deliberately on another population are excluded by name: Expected (live book), Predicted (model PD), Cumulative (Vintage Curve), Observed (model test set), Color (formatting helper).
Expression: RegEx.IsMatch(Name, "(?i)(default|loss|prepayment) rate") and not RegEx.IsMatch(Name, "(?i)expected|predicted|cumulative|observed|color") and not RegEx.IsMatch(Expression, "LC\.MaturedOnly|Matured|\[Default Rate\]|\[Loss Rate\]")
